description: Tests whether the Masbaum cyclotomic coefficient mixed-sign supplies the Δ_λ row-grading sign (-1)^{n(λ)}. Identity sgn(w_0^{S_{λ'}})=(-1)^{n(λ)} confirmed; cyclotomic sign is per-integer-n while Δ_λ sign is per-partition — index-matching wall. scope-(a): needs GS-filtration refinement (qou-my68). No fit; no c_k.

assertions.name: chirality_sign_eq_row_grading
assertions.source: sgn(w_0^{S_{λ'}}) = (-1)^{Σ_j C(λ'_j,2)} = (-1)^{n(λ)} — the Δ_λ chirality sign IS the row-grading (-1)^{n(λ)} (= q^{2n(λ)} at q²=-1). Confirms the Nakayama-witness framing.

assertions.name: cyclotomic_coeff_sign_is_minus1_pow_n
assertions.source: the Masbaum 5₂ cyclotomic coefficient has sgn(C_{5₂,n})=(-1)^n at real q₀>1 (the (-1)^n prefactor times a positive q-binomial sum) — one sign per INTEGER n

assertions.name: index_matching_wall_is_real
assertions.source: (-1)^{n(λ)} is MIXED across partitions of the same n (e.g. n=3: λ=(3)→+, (2,1)→-, (1³)→-), while the cyclotomic coefficient gives ONE sign per integer n. So the cyclotomic mixed-sign is at the WRONG RESOLUTION — it cannot, alone, supply the per-partition Δ_λ sign. scope-(a) narrowing, not an ingredient refutation: the per-λ resolution is the GS-filtration refinement (bean qou-my68). This check PASSES when the wall is confirmed real.

assertions.name: aggregate_also_fails_to_match
assertions.source: the SYT-weighted aggregate Σ_{λ⊢n}(-1)^{n(λ)} f^λ sign does NOT match the cyclotomic per-n sign (-1)^n (mismatch at n=1,2,4,5,6) — so the cyclotomic coefficient does not even carry the correctly signed tr_M-level aggregate chirality. The negative is STRENGTHENED: cyclotomic sign fails to supply Δ_λ both per-partition AND in aggregate. Passes = confirmed non-match (the strengthened negative).

result.verdict: HONEST NEGATIVE (scope-(a)) — the direct cyclotomic-sign route does NOT close Δ_λ. What holds: (i) the Δ_λ chirality sign sgn(w_0^{S_{λ'}}) = (-1)^{n(λ)} EXACTLY (row-grading at q²=-1; the per-n spread 1+/2- (n=3), 6+/5- (n=6) reproduces the corpus PROBE-4 deltaSign, cross-validating the identity); (ii) the Masbaum coefficients ARE mixed-sign, sgn(C_{5₂,n})=(-1)^n. What FAILS: the mixed sign is at the WRONG RESOLUTION — (-1)^{n(λ)} is mixed WITHIN each n (per-partition), while the cyclotomic coefficient carries ONE sign per INTEGER n, so it cannot resolve the per-λ sign; and the SYT-weighted AGGREGATE Σ(-1)^{n(λ)}f^λ does not even sign-match (-1)^n (n=1,2,4,5,6), so it is not the signed tr_M aggregate either. CONCLUSION: the KL-prune EVASION via cyclotomic signs is REFUTED as a direct Δ_λ source — a real mixed sign exists but neither resolves per-partition nor matches in aggregate. This NARROWS the search: any cyclotomic→Δ_λ route MUST go through a partition-refinement that splits C_{K,n} into per-λ pieces (the GS-filtration bridge, bean qou-my68) — the naive sign-transfer is closed. No fit; no c_k wired.
